subject.title: fix(reef): bound JSONL store file reads to prevent OOM on oversized audit/replay stores

question: Should Reef preserve existing oversized audit/replay stores through bounded streaming or compaction, rather than imposing an unconditional 32 MiB read-time failure?
rationale: The concrete race is mechanically fixable, but the permanent operator contract for oversized persisted audit and replay state determines whether a hard limit, retention policy, or recovery workflow is acceptable.

options.title: Use bounded streaming and recovery
options.body: Implement a bounded/streaming reader and provide compaction or a Doctor repair path so existing stores do not unexpectedly become unreadable.

options.title: Accept a hard 32 MiB rejection
options.body: Keep the fail-closed cutoff only with explicit maintainer approval, documented operator recovery, and upgrade coverage for already-large stores.

recommendation.title: Use bounded streaming and recovery
recommendation.body: Implement a bounded/streaming reader and provide compaction or a Doctor repair path so existing stores do not unexpectedly become unreadable.
